adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling designating 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist - November 2023; unified list entry 22 March 2024
adds.summary: On 30 November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist, entered in the federal extremist list on 22 March 2024, banning its activity nationwide including Tatarstan and making participation, financing, and public display of LGBT including trans-related symbols punishable under extremism administrative and criminal law for visitors.
